'''Planks''' are blocks from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Crafting Table]] recipes and [[Stonecutter]] recipes for the 11 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Planks}} for everything else.
